Application.Text1:
protocols:
protocol_id: P_A_clearing
sample_id: A
branch: A_cleared_femur_LSFM
method: ethyl cinnamate-based clearing; adapted from Grüneboom 2019
fixed_tissue_conditions: 
  [1]     operation: postfixation of excised femur
    reagent: 4% paraformaldehyde
    duration: 24 h
    temperature: 4°C
  [2]     operation: dehydration
    reagent: 50%, then 70%, then 100% ethanol twice
    duration_raw: for 24 h
    temperature: 4°C
    duration_binding: Original sentence ambiguous regarding per-bath versus entire series; no total computed.
  [3]     operation: RI matching
    reagent: ethyl cinnamate 98%
    duration: overnight
    temperature: room temperature
  [4]     operation: pre-microCT storage
    reagent: 100% ethanol
    temperature: 4°C
    duration: null (as recorded in source)
decalcification: Not assigned to cleared femur. EDTA decalcification belongs to the other femur, cryosection branch.
label: Lycopersicon esculentum tomato lectin–DyLight649, existing vascular label; administration details out of extraction scope
source: JATS /article/body/sec[4]/sec[2]/sec[1]/p
total_processing_hours: null (as recorded in source)

Application.Text11:
additional_contextual_results:
id: C1
branch: A_microCT
source: Figure1; Supplementary Figure1; Results
finding: Cortical thickness rises 0.06 mm (43%) from growing to mature, then falls 0.05 mm (26%) from mature to aged; contrasts p<0.001 and p<0.05. Medullary volume and periosteal perimeter correlate positively with age, rs=0.85 and 0.75, both p<0.0001. Cortical volume rises 75% during maturation; no significant aging difference. Not clearing performance.

Application.Text12:
additional_contextual_results:
id: C2
branch: B_microdissected_osteocyte_RNA_and_section_IF
source: Figure4; Results
finding: Pdpn mRNA is sixfold higher in growing than mature (p<0.01), but percentage of Podoplanin-positive cells shows no significant group difference. Gja1 mRNA falls in middle-aged/aged versus mature and correlates with age (rs=-0.75,p<0.0001); Cx43 dots per cell body differ growing versus mature, not significantly during aging. mRNA abundance and protein-positive cells/dots are distinct endpoints.

Application.Text13:
additional_contextual_results:
id: C3
branch: B_microdissected_osteocyte_RNA_and_section_IF
source: Figure5; Results
finding: Sost,Dmp1,Phex expression did not significantly vary with age groups; Dmp1/Phex correlate (rs=0.80,p<0.0001). Sclerostin-positive fraction shows no significant group difference. PHEX-positive fraction is lower in middle-aged than mature (p<0.05). Aged sclerostin image intensity is qualitative, not validated quantitative clearing preservation.

Application.Text14:
additional_contextual_results:
id: C4
branch: B_section_network_and_IF; A_contralateral_EF5_sections
source: Figure6; Results and Methods EF5
finding: GFP/phalloidin images show proximity/connections of vessels and dendrites. Vegfa expression shows no significant age-group effect. BNIP3-positive fraction is higher in growing than mature (p<0.05); aged BNIP3 positivity is not equivalent to proven hypoxia. EF5 is qualitative and assessed in growing/mature preparation-A sections only. Neither network proximity nor unchanged Vegfa establishes causal oxygen transport.

Note.Text4:
interpretation_boundaries:
Cross-sectional age comparison, not longitudinal tracking of the same mice.

Note.Text5:
interpretation_boundaries:
No claim of quantitative GFP preservation under ethyl cinnamate: cleared readout is lectin–DyLight649; GFP vessel counting is separate cryosection branch.

Note.Text6:
interpretation_boundaries:
Age ranges and 4–7/13–16-month maturation/aging intervals are not processing times.

Note.Text7:
interpretation_boundaries:
No clearing-method comparison or claim that EC is superior.

Note.Text8:
interpretation_boundaries:
50 animals overall =22 in A+28 in B; neither imaging voxels nor 60–150 osteocytes per animal are independent biological n.

Note.Text9:
interpretation_boundaries:
Fig2D axis uses BV volume/bone volume (10^-3); retain underlying dimensionless volume ratio, not vessels/mm3 or unqualified percent.

Note.Text10:
completion_scope:
Task-relevant fixed-tissue clearing, imaging, connected biological outcomes, and all figures/tables/videos; not extraction of animal interventions or primer sequences
